title: The Lamps of Tallowford
markup: Words in [square brackets] are key words: the talk panel shows them in its one accent colour. Speaker 'narration' is unvoiced text on the panel with no name. Speaker 'prompt' is the kit's glyph prompt.

pell.name: Pell
pell.voice: Ferry child, paper hat. Quick, practical, never explains the plot.

trim.name: Old Trim
trim.voice: The lamp-maker. Slow, dry, proud of his wicks.

marrow.name: Marrow
marrow.voice: The dyer. Loud, brisk, warm under it.

brindle.name: Brindle
brindle.voice: The well-keeper. Counts things. Worries kindly.

flax.name: Flax
flax.voice: About eight. In charge of her brother, and of everything else.

pibbet.name: Pibbet
pibbet.voice: About six. One or two words at a time.

wherry.name: Aunt Wherry
wherry.voice: Keeps the ferry-house; Pell's aunt. Dry, unflappable.

netmender.name: The net-mender
netmender.voice: Neighbour. Thin, quiet, a little rueful.

fisher.name: The old fisher
fisher.voice: Neighbour. Leans on a cane; sees the funny side.

verse.name: Verse-stone
verse.voice: The Ink-maker's own words, carved and remembered. Four lines each.

scenes.trigger: Level start: the raft has tied up at M_Raft; Orimi stands at M_Spawn. Plays once.
lines: You can usually see it from the bend. Every window lit.
Not one tonight. Not even old [Trim]'s, and he never lets his go out.
His house is just up the road. I'll mind the raft.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Pell at the raft before Trim's lamp is lit. Repeats.
lines: Trim's. Up the road. The house with all the lanterns.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Old Trim while he is grey. Repeats.
lines: Old Trim stands grey and still, one hand raised to a cold wick.

scenes.trigger: Orimi comes within 4 m of verse-stone 1 while it is grey. Once.
lines: A stone carved with verse. The letters have gone grey, as if they're thirsty.

scenes.trigger: Bloom on verse-stone 1. The stone speaks, then grants Kindle.
lines: I came here for the black inside your lamps,
the soft soot a good wick leaves at dusk.
A light goes out; its dark stays gentle.
I thought that I could keep it so.
The last line glows like a wick. New glyph: [Kindle]. Open the brush and dab once, short and firm, on a wick.

scenes.trigger: Kindle on Old Trim's lamp (M_Kindle_Trim). Colour spreads from the lamp; Trim wakes. Plays once.
lines: Hm? Who let my lamp go out?
A paper fox. With a brush. Well. That's a first, and I've seen a few firsts.
Something came down the river at dusk, black as a shut eye. Every lamp in the village went out at once.
Funny. It put me in mind of a customer I had. An ink-maker, from upriver.
He bought my [lamp-black], the soot off the wicks. A jar a year, at first. Then a cartload.
I asked what he wanted with so much dark. He said, 'Somewhere to keep the colours safe.' Never did follow him.
Go and see [Marrow] at the dye yard, west of the square. If someone's shouting, it'll be her. If no one is, worry.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Old Trim again after he wakes, before the finale. Repeats.
lines: Dye yard. West. Follow the smell of wet wool.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Pell after Trim wakes, before the ford-lamp. Repeats.
lines: That's one lamp. Tallowford has a lot of lamps. You'd better get going.

scenes.trigger: Orimi comes within 6 m of the bound vats. Once.
lines: Black thorns have knotted themselves round the dye vats.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Marrow while she is grey. Repeats.
lines: Marrow stands grey to the elbows, her paddle lifted over a vat she can't reach.

scenes.trigger: Slash cuts the thorns from the vats (thorns_cut).
lines: The vats are free. The dyer's lamp is still cold.

scenes.trigger: Kindle on Marrow's lamp (M_Kindle_Marrow), after the vats are freed. Plays once.
lines: And another thing! Oh. Where did everybody go?
Look at my vats. Grey indigo. Do you know how hard it is to make indigo grey? Apparently not hard at all.
That's colour coming back round the lamp, isn't it? Then light them all, fox. Every one.
[Brindle]'s well is down the lane to the south-east. Can't dye without water. Can't do anything without water.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Marrow again, before the finale. Repeats.
lines: If you're done admiring my vats: Brindle. The well. Go.

scenes.trigger: Orimi comes within 5 m of the well. Once.
lines: Soot has packed the well to the brim, thick as fleece.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Brindle while he is grey. Repeats.
lines: Brindle stands grey in his doorway with an empty bucket, lips parted mid-count.

scenes.trigger: Gust clears the soot from the well (soot_cleared).
lines: The soot blows off down the lane. Brindle's lamp still waits.

scenes.trigger: Kindle on Brindle's lamp (M_Kindle_Brindle), after the well is cleared. Plays once.
lines: Forty-one. I was on forty-one buckets.
Then everything went quiet, and I've no idea where forty-two got to.
You've cleared the well! You've no idea how glad that makes me. Well. You have some idea. You did it.
Have you seen the little ones? [Flax] and [Pibbet]. They were playing under the [persimmon] in the square when it all went dark.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Brindle again, before the finale. Repeats.
lines: The square. The big bare tree. They'll be near it. They always are.

scenes.trigger: Orimi comes within 7 m of the persimmon while it is bare. Once.
lines: The persimmon in the square stands bare. Not a leaf. Not one fruit.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Flax or Pibbet while they are grey. Repeats.
lines: Two children stand grey by their door, halfway through a game of tag.

scenes.trigger: Bloom on the persimmon.
lines: Leaves, then fruit, all at once, like a lamp turned up.

scenes.trigger: Kindle on the children's lamp (M_Kindle_Children), after the tree blooms. Plays once.
lines: Pibbet, you're it, and no tagging back — oh.
It's a paper fox, Pibbet. Don't poke it.
Thank you for the tree. The fruit wasn't due till winter. You've done it early. That's allowed, I think.
Are you lighting all of them? You have to do Aunt [Wherry]'s at the [ferry-house], down by the jetty. She'll be cross if you skip her.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Flax or Pibbet again, before the finale. Repeats, alternating.
Talk to Aunt Wherry while she is grey. Repeats.
lines: A woman in a river-grey coat stands in the ferry-house door, watching the water.

scenes.trigger: Kindle on the ferry-house lamp (M_Kindle_Ferry). The sealed fight starts on the jetty square as the line ends.
lines: The lamplight reaches across the river, and the river flinches.

scenes.trigger: The sealed fight ends (every enemy in the ring gone). Wherry wakes. Plays once.
lines: Well. That's the second strangest thing I've seen on this jetty.
First was my nephew poling a raft upstream with his hat on backwards.
You're with Pell, then. Good. Somebody ought to be.
The ferry can't cross blind. The [ford-lamp]'s out on its post, up the north path, and something's hooded it.
Get that off and light it, and every lamp in Tallowford will remember what it's for.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Aunt Wherry again, before the finale. Repeats.
lines: North path. Tall post, out in the water. You can't miss it. Well. You could. Don't.

scenes.trigger: Orimi comes within 4 m of verse-stone 2 while it is grey. Once.
lines: Another stone of verse, grey as the first.

scenes.trigger: Bloom on verse-stone 2 (optional).
lines: Every colour, folded into one black:
I ground it fine, and then I ground it finer.
The vat grew heavy as a held breath,
and still I would not let it go.

scenes.trigger: Orimi comes within 8 m of the ford-lamp while it is hooded. Once.
lines: The ford-lamp wears a hood of soot, pulled down over its eyes.

scenes.trigger: Gust strips the soot hood (soot_cleared on the hood).
lines: The hood tumbles into the river. High on the post, a wick waits.

scenes.trigger: Kindle on the ford-lamp (M_Kindle_Ford), hood removed. Every lamp flares, colour returns to the whole village, the cottages' lamps light one by one, and everyone gathers by the jetty. Cutscene.
lines: Next stop's the [plain]. It's windy. Hold on to your ears.
A bead is added to Orimi's cord: [lamp gold]. The ink pot grows.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Pell at M_PellWait after the finale. Repeats. Choosing to board leaves the level.
lines: Ready when you are. Hop on.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Old Trim after the finale. Repeats.
lines: If you meet that ink-maker upriver, tell him I want my jars back.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Marrow after the finale. Repeats.
lines: Come back in spring. I'll dye you a scarf. Something loud.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Brindle after the finale. Repeats.
lines: Forty-three, forty-four... Oh, don't mind me. Safe travels.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Flax or Pibbet after the finale. Repeats.
lines: Pibbet wants to know if you're it.

scenes.trigger: Talk to Aunt Wherry after the finale. Repeats.
lines: Keep him dry. And turn his hat round.

scenes.trigger: Talk to the baker (M_Person_Neighbour_1) after the finale. Repeats.
lines: Bread's late tonight. First time in thirty years. I blame the dark, not my oven.

scenes.trigger: Talk to the net-mender (M_Person_Neighbour_2) after the finale. Repeats.
lines: Everything went grey, and I mended a whole net before I noticed.

scenes.trigger: Talk to the old fisher (M_Person_Neighbour_3) after the finale. Repeats.
lines: River's bright again. The fish won't know what to do with themselves.
